The last three digits of the repetend are the digits at positions 724, 725, and 726. Since $r_k = 10^k \bmod 727$ and each digit is $d_k = \lfloor 10r_{k-1}/727 \rfloor$:

- $10^{-1} \equiv 509 \pmod{727}$, because $10 \cdot 509 = 5090 = 5089 + 1 = 7\cdot727 + 1$. So $r_{725} = 509$ and $r_{726} = 1$.
- $r_{724} \equiv 509^2 = 259081 \equiv 269 \pmod{727}$, since $259081 - 356\cdot727 = 269$.
- $r_{723} \equiv 269 \cdot 509^{-1}$, or equivalently $10\,r_{723} = 269 + 3\cdot727 = 2450$, so $r_{723} = 245$.

The digits are then:
- $d_{724} = \lfloor 2450/727 \rfloor = 3$
- $d_{725} = \lfloor 2690/727 \rfloor = 3$
- $d_{726} = \lfloor 5090/727 \rfloor = 7$

This gives 337. Solution 1's remainder chain ($r_{725}=509$, $r_{724}=269$, $r_{723}=245$) and its digit computations are correct.
